name: smwgraphics-arkanoid-doh-it-again
title: Arkanoid: Doh It Again
description:
Submitted during Summer C3 2021!

Ever wanted to use a pretty-lookin' computer font for sci-fi themed hacks? Well, wait no longer. This is a rip of a font used in Arkanoid: Doh It Again. Includes both for message box dialogues and for pre-credits cutscene. So come brick it, (scout of) commander Therle!
